en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.35 - Kurdawiyah al-Hamdani asked Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about
a well into which water from the road flows, containing urine, feces, animal urine and droppings, and dog excrement.
Imam (as) said: "Thirty buckets should be drawn from it, especially if it has a bad odor”.
